scientific_integrity: All claims have analytic arguments; stochastic checks are expressly not proofs; no independent verification performed.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed convex polyhedra locally; exact box formula limited to radius at most shortest side; intrinsic metric, volume sampling, and full-histogram identifiability excluded. Historic priority qualified by inaccessible 1999 and 2001 full texts.
title: Dihedral-edge law for short surface-chord distances and locally indistinguishable boxes
